start_welcome:
🛡️ *SQUARES Vault*

Your personal document assistant is active and monitoring all upcoming deadlines.

• *Add Documents:* Send a photo or PDF of any document anytime.
• *Ask Questions:* Tap *💬 Ask Your Vault* below or send `/ask` to query any document or expense.
help_text:
🛡️ *SQUARES Vault Help*

• Send any photo or PDF anytime to store a document.
• Use the menu below to Search, Browse, or view Upcoming dates.
• Tap 💬 *Ask Your Vault* to ask questions about your records.

Need assistance? Contact the administrator directly via this chat.
err_group_chat: Sorry, SQUARES Vault only works in private chats.

admin_only: This command is only available to the bot owner.
onboarding_consent:
🛡️ *SQUARES Vault*
*Your Personal Document Assistant*

Organize your vehicles, insurance, warranties, and bills in one private place.

• *Private Storage:* Files save directly to your own Google Drive.
• *Smart Alerts:* Reminders before every expiry and due date.
• *Ask Anything:* Instant answers about any document or expense.

_You must be 18+ to proceed._
onboarding_rejected:
❌ *Access Declined*

SQUARES Vault requires age verification (18+) and agreement to our Terms & Privacy Policy.

Tap /start whenever you are ready to begin.
onboarding_invite_prompt:
🔑 *Invite Code Verification*

SQUARES Vault is currently in private beta (limited to 100 members).

Please enter your invite code below to continue:
onboarding_invite_invalid:
❌ *Invalid or Expired Invite Code*

The code provided could not be verified or has already been redeemed. Please check your invitation code and try again:
onboarding_tz_prompt:
🌐 *Timezone Setup*

To ensure your renewal reminders arrive at the right time in your city:

Reply with your city/timezone (e.g. `Asia/Kolkata`, `Europe/London`), or send `skip` for default (*Asia/Kolkata*):
onboarding_tz_invalid:
⚠️ *Unrecognized Timezone*

Please provide a valid timezone name (e.g. `Asia/Kolkata`, `America/New_York`), or reply with `skip` to use the default (*Asia/Kolkata*).
onboarding_done:
✨ *Setup Complete*

Your private vault is ready to use.

📸 Send a photo or PDF of any document (vehicle RC, insurance, warranty, or bill) to get started!
